rows.text: The water cycle is how water moves around the Earth. It starts when water from oceans, lakes, and rivers turns into water vapor and rises into the air. This is called evaporation. The water vapor cools and turns back into liquid, forming clouds. This is called condensation. When the clouds get heavy, the water falls back to the ground as rain or snow. This is called precipitation. The water then flows back into rivers, lakes, and oceans, and the cycle starts again.

rows.text: Vaccines work by teaching your immune system how to recognize and fight off specific germs, like viruses or bacteria. They contain a small, harmless piece of the germ, or a weakened version, which triggers your body to produce antibodies. These antibodies remember the germ, so if you're exposed to it later, your immune system can quickly respond and protect you. This helps prevent serious illness or reduces its severity. Vaccines are safe, effective, and a key tool in preventing the spread of infectious diseases.

rows.text: The tallest mountain in Africa is Mount Kilimanjaro. It is located in Tanzania, near the border with Kenya. Mount Kilimanjaro is a free-standing mountain, meaning it is not part of a mountain range. It has three distinct volcanic cones: Kibo, Mawenzi, and Shira. Kibo is the highest peak, reaching an elevation of about five thousand eight hundred and ninety five meters, or nineteen thousand three hundred and forty one feet. The mountain is a popular destination for hikers and climbers, though the climb can be challenging due to the altitude. Mount Kilimanjaro is also a significant cultural and natural landmark in East Africa.

Check the weather forecast before you go. Let someone know your hiking plans and expected return time. This will help ensure a safe and enjoyable trip. Always prioritize safety and be prepared for changing conditions. Have a great hike!

rows.text: A good habit for better sleep is to establish a consistent bedtime routine. This helps signal your body that it's time to wind down, making it easier to fall asleep and stay asleep throughout the night. Activities like reading a book or taking a warm bath can relax your mind and body, reducing stress and preparing you for restful sleep. Consistency reinforces this routine, improving sleep quality over time. A regular sleep schedule also helps regulate your body's internal clock, leading to more restful and restorative sleep each night.

rows.text: The tallest mountain in Africa is Mount Kilimanjaro. It is located in Tanzania, near the border with Kenya. Mount Kilimanjaro is a free-standing mountain, meaning it is not part of a mountain range. It stands at about five thousand nine hundred and five meters, or just over nineteen thousand feet, above sea level. The mountain is made up of three distinct volcanic cones. It is a popular destination for hikers and climbers, though the climb can be challenging due to the high altitude. The mountain is also a significant source of water for the surrounding region.

rows.text: Copper is used in electrical wiring because it conducts electricity very well. It is also used in plumbing for pipes because it is durable and resistant to corrosion. Copper's excellent conductivity makes it efficient for transmitting electrical signals with minimal loss. Its resistance to rust and long lifespan in plumbing ensure reliable water transport and prevent leaks. These properties make copper a preferred material in both electrical and plumbing applications.
